principle: Unknown to us is not the same as unknown to the city, and neither is the same as not measured anywhere.

hacks.title: Find the Drain
hacks.strapline: Turn visible drainage clues into verification tasks.
hacks.gap: We do not have a complete open street-level layer showing every inlet, grate, kerb opening or visible drainage clue.
hacks.method: Use current street imagery or a short field capture to detect candidate visible drainage objects. Keep each detection attached to image date, source and spatial uncertainty.
hacks.output: Candidate visible-drainage observations with evidence, location uncertainty and review state.
hacks.confidence: Object-level confidence + image/date provenance + optional multi-view agreement.
hacks.validation: Image review → field observation → authority/operator confirmation where needed.
hacks.limit: Cannot infer pipe route, connectivity, invert level, capacity or excavation clearance.
hacks.next_action: Create a review or field task; for shortlisted sites request authoritative drainage / utility evidence.

hacks.title: Rain Walk
hacks.strapline: Create the current street evidence that no map can provide.
hacks.gap: Public datasets rarely show what actually happens on one street during or immediately after rain.
hacks.method: Guide a user through a 5-minute capture of kerbs, inlets, tree pits, surface condition, ponding, blockage and apparent flow direction; AI pre-tags observations and the user confirms them.
hacks.output: Time-specific street observations: ponding, blockage, apparent flow, visible surface condition and candidate capture points.
hacks.confidence: Observation status + timestamp + reviewer confirmation + repeat observations.
hacks.validation: Contributor confirmation → project review → repeat after rainfall / field survey.
hacks.gatekeeper: No gatekeeper for observation itself; authority or operator remains gatekeeper for network truth.
hacks.limit: Does not prove underground routing, hydraulic capacity, soil infiltration or future storm behaviour.
hacks.next_action: Attach observations to the Evidence Passport and escalate unresolved engineering questions.

hacks.title: Find the Disagreement
hacks.strapline: When sources disagree, create a question instead of a verdict.
hacks.gap: Official layers, imagery, field observations and project documents can be incomplete, stale or mutually inconsistent.
hacks.method: Compare two or more evidence sources for the same street feature and flag conflicts in presence, class, date or condition.
hacks.output: Evidence-conflict record with both sources, plausible explanations and a verification task.
hacks.confidence: Conflict is factual only when the underlying source values are traceable; explanations remain hypotheses.
hacks.validation: Remote review → current imagery → field check → holder confirmation.
hacks.gatekeeper: Whichever authority, operator or project owner owns the stronger source for the disputed fact.
hacks.limit: A discrepancy does not prove which source is wrong or that the street changed.
hacks.next_action: Resolve remotely when possible; otherwise generate the cheapest field or gatekeeper action.
